description:
About our brand and products:

Tix & Mix creates magical, screen-free play environments for children. We specialize in premium magnetic wall decals and wooden magnets that transform any room into a space for creative discovery. Our products are designed to inspire curiosity and nurture developmental growth through hands-on, imaginative play.

What makes us different: 

We move away from digital distractions, focusing instead on high-quality, sustainable materials like wood. We believe in the power of Montessori-inspired learning; our products are not just toys—they are tools for kids to build their own worlds, fostering independence and creativity without the need for screens.
payout_period: Payouts are processed on the 1st day of each month for affiliates who have earned over 50 EUR.
term_and_condition:
1. Acceptance and Approval

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program Registration at our sole discretion. We prioritize affiliates who create original content (blogs, social media, reviews). You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your application.

2. Prohibited Search Engine Marketing (The "Anti-Scam" Clause)

To protect the integrity of the Tix & Mix brand, affiliates must adhere to strict search engine marketing rules:

  • No Brand Bidding: You are strictly prohibited from bidding on "Tix & Mix" trademarked terms, or any variations/misspellings (e.g., "TixMix", "Tix and Mix") on Google Ads, Bing Ads, or other PPC platforms.

  • No Direct Linking: You may not run ads that link directly to tix-mix.com. All paid traffic must land on your own original content (a landing page, blog, or social media post) before redirecting to our store.

  • Negative Keywords: You must add "Tix & Mix" as a negative keyword in any "magnetic wall board" related campaigns to ensure your ads do not appear for brand-specific searches.

  • Penalty: Violation of these rules will result in immediate termination from the program and the forfeiture of all unpaid commissions.

3. Links, Coupons, and Content

  • Value-Add Requirement: Affiliates are expected to provide value. This includes writing reviews, creating videos, or sharing personal experiences on social networks.

  • Attribution: We operate on a "Last Click" basis. If a customer clicks multiple affiliate links, the last link clicked before the purchase receives the credit.

  • Coupons: You may only promote coupons explicitly assigned to you in the Dashboard. Unauthorized promotion of "site-wide" or "leaked" codes is prohibited.

4. Commissions and Payments

  • Structure: Commissions are calculated on the net order value (excluding taxes, shipping, and returns).

  • Review Period: All orders are subject to a [Insert Number, e.g., 30-day] hold period to account for potential returns or chargebacks.

  • Fair Use: We reserve the right to audit any referral. If we suspect fraudulent activity or "traffic hijacking," we may withhold payment until the source of traffic is verified.

5. Tracking and Cookies

We use cookies to track referrals. For a commission to be generated:

  • The customer must have cookies enabled.

  • The purchase must occur within the [Insert Number] day cookie window.

  • If a customer clears their cookies or uses a different browser/device that wasn't tracked, a commission cannot be assigned.

6. Termination

Either party may terminate this agreement at any time. Tix & Mix reserves the right to terminate your account immediately and without notice if you breach any of these terms, specifically those regarding PPC and Brand Bidding.
